labels.name: Burrow
labels.function: Tunnel under the surface; classic in finger and toe webs

labels.name: Female mite
labels.function: Dermoscopy: flat triangle of head and four front legs

labels.name: Eggs
labels.function: Often visible on microscopy even when the parasite is not

labels.name: Scybala
labels.function: Fecal pellets seen in a mineral oil scraping

labels.name: Nit
labels.function: Cemented in place; unlike pseudonits, does not slide

labels.name: Hair shaft
labels.function: Long, straight, low-sebum ones are highest risk for infestation

labels.name: Botfly larva
labels.function: Causes a boil-like lesion after travel to Latin America

labels.name: Punctum
labels.function: Breathing tunnel to the surface; treat by excision or I&D

labels.name: Finger web spaces
labels.function: Classic site of papules and burrows

labels.name: Wrists
labels.function: Rarely spared; examine with thenar and hypothenar skin

labels.name: Axillae
labels.function: Part of the circular distribution named after von Hebra

labels.name: Breasts
labels.function: Upper limb of the circular truncal distribution

labels.name: Periumbilical area
labels.function: Midline trunk site in the ring of lesions

labels.name: Genitals
labels.function: Look here for bite-like papules and nodules

labels.name: Ankles
labels.function: Lower-limb site of lesions along with the toe webs

labels.name: Toe web spaces
labels.function: Where the female burrows and lays eggs in the feet

labels.name: Face and scalp
labels.function: Spared in adults and older children, but not in infants

labels.name: Head lice
labels.function: Nits glued to hair; spread by shared hats and brushes

labels.name: Romana sign
labels.function: Reduviid bug bite near the eye; Trypanosoma cruzi

labels.name: Body lice
labels.function: Pinpoint torso and underarm bites; live in clothing seams

labels.name: Bed bug bites
labels.function: Row of three or more night-time bites with a central apex

labels.name: Thumbprint purpura
labels.function: Dissemination of a soil nematode in immunocompromised hosts

labels.name: Pubic lice
labels.function: Sexually spread; can also infest eyelashes and eyebrows

labels.name: Flea bites
labels.function: Itchy papule or nodule typical of the lower legs and ankles

labels.name: Cutaneous larva migrans
labels.function: Serpiginous track from dog and cat hookworm in sand
